note: Both sets share 17 essentially identical claims and both read the dimension strings correctly. Set A adds a plywood-deck thickness claim (3/4" from '3/4" X 5 1/2" PLYWOOD DECK'), while Set B instead restates the hex through bolt callout twice more as separate length (4") and diameter (3/8") claims on top of its 'dimensions 3/8" X 4"' claim — three claims for one callout. Neither set contains a factually wrong value, but B's bolt triple is redundant, so A is slightly cleaner and marginally more complete.
remarks: Both sets leave out several labeled items on the page: 2" X 8" FRAME, 2" X 8" JOIST, COMMON WOOD NAILS OR SCREWS, and the 5 1/2" width of the plywood deck. The 'deck module section' height/width claims (1 1/4", 3 3/4") and 'span 5-6' are weakly bound in both sets — the 1 1/4"/3 3/4"/4 1/4"/1'-0" strings sit in the A6 landscape footing detail, not clearly in a deck-module section. 'SLEVE' is a misspelling of 'sleeve' in the source text layer, faithfully quoted by both.
